newest_only.note: Only the newest generation per model family is eligible: older versions (claude-opus-4-7/4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6, qwen3.7-max, deepseek-v4-flash) are dropped from suggestions and ladders even if available. Keys are id prefixes; the value is the one id to keep for that family.

spawn_defaults.note: Omit model to inherit the coordinator's model. Per-role suggestions below are checked against available routes at launch; the user approves, changes, or removes them before any worker spawns.

role_tiers.note: Per-role score-acceptance threshold (fraction of best available score). Higher = more selective (only near-best models qualify), lower = more cost-aggressive. Critical roles (pm/architect/qa) stay at 0.95; implementation roles at 0.92; non-critical advisory roles at 0.80. This replaces the old flat --tier 0.92 flag.

role_effort.note: Default reasoning effort per role when the model supports it. Advisory roles get 'low' (cheaper, faster); implementation roles get 'medium'. The user can override at GATE 1.

model_suggestions.note: Model choices are COMPUTED at launch, not hardcoded. The launch flow runs `swarm list_models`, saves the output, then `python TPL/tools/recommend.py --available <file>` which scores each available model per role's purpose (benchmarks.json), keeps the best tier, and picks the cheapest of that tier. The table is then presented for user OK/edit/remove. `purpose` below is the role -> benchmark-purpose weight map used by the recommender.

waves.note: Discovery: map existing codebase via graphify into out/architect/current-state.md

waves.gate: User approves roster proposal + model selections
User reviews plan/architecture summary; then run pm-kb-enrich
Verification gate: tests + acceptance criteria pass

roster_rules.greenfield: justify roles by the type of product being built
roster_rules.brownfield: justify roles by the IMPACT SURFACE in out/architect/current-state.md: which modules the change touches. A change touching no UI gets no designer/frontend.

pm.name: Project Manager / Planner
pm.when: Always first. Drafts charter, phased plan with task graph, and the minimal team proposal.

architect.name: Project Architect
architect.when: Any project with code or infrastructure. Owns ADRs, module boundaries, API contracts, data model.

designer.name: Designer
designer.when: Projects with a user-facing surface. Owns UI spec, design tokens, states, accessibility requirements.

backend.name: Backend Developer
backend.when: Server-side logic, APIs, data persistence, integrations.

frontend.name: Frontend Developer
frontend.when: Client-side UI implementation against the designer's spec.

business.name: Business Advisor
business.when: Products with a monetization, market, or viability question.

marketing.name: Marketing Manager
marketing.when: Projects needing positioning, launch assets, landing page copy, or channel plan.

qa.name: QA / Test Engineer
qa.when: Always for projects with code. Runs the verification gate against acceptance criteria.

devops.name: DevOps Engineer
devops.when: Projects needing CI, deployment, environments, secrets, backups, or observability. Also carries security hardening.

legal.name: Legal Advisor (Risk & Policy)
legal.when: Every project: regulatory risk assessment for the charter's deployment jurisdictions. Strict mode (config.json legal_strict) does a jurisdiction pack + gate blocking; light mode is advisory only.
